title: A Temporal Network Approach to Paranoia: A Pilot Study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Low ESM compliance leading to limited data; - Data did not meet normality assumptions; - Network models are low dimensional and may omit important variables; - No tools available to test robustness of temporal network estimates; - Results are hypothesis-generating but not sufficient to draw robust causal conclusions.
notes: The study was part of a larger randomized controlled trial registered at ClinicalTrials.gov. The data, ESM items, and R code are publicly available via the Open Science Framework (OSF) at https://osf.io/7tk4b/. The study used a mixed platform for ESM data collection (PACO APP initially, then Qualtrics).
